ios.desc:
Get your own personalized newsletter sent directly to your inbox!

Newslater generates a daily newsletter for you based on the articles you save to your reading list. Each day you’ll receive a summary of five of the articles from your reading list at a time that suits you. Whether you want your newsletter for your morning commute, during your lunch break, or for some light evening reading, you choose when you want to receive your newsletter.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Newslater – A Personal Newsletter Generator

quotes.text:
Inspired by my ability to collect articles from HN that I wanted to read, but never getting around to reading them, I built Newslater. You add the articles you want to read to your reading list, and Newslater will email you a newsletter containing summaries of 5 of your articles sent at a time you choose. My aim was to create a tl;dr newsletter from articles you are actually interested in.

The app is free, has no ads, and is available on Android and iOS:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=co.readlater.readlater 
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/readlater-personal-newsletter/id6469415216

It’s a bit rough, but I thought some others may be interested in giving it a go. You can see examples of the newsletters it generates here too https://newslater.co/
